text:
matt: CI went red on my PR (https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/4321) — typecheck + format failures. Anyone available for a quick triage? :eyes:

ci-bot: pipeline #build/9876 failed — jobs: typecheck-py-right, mypy, rustfmt, pre-commit. Logs: https://ci.internal/build/9876/logs

priya: can you paste the failing error lines / sha? I can try to repro locally.

matt: repro SHA: a1b2c3d4. Local repro (mac, py3.11): `./scripts/run-typecheck.sh` -> mypy errors. Quick paste:
```
src/redwood/utils/kvcache.py:128: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Optional[int]", variable has type "int")  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```

alex: that looks like the new nullable change on kv cache. Could be mypy strictness bump from pyright/pyproject update. Try `git checkout a1b2c3d4 && git bisect start HEAD~10 a1b2c3d4` to narrow. I can run bisect if someone gives green/ red hints.

jamie: I noticed earlier we merged a tiny stub change in `shared-protos` that relaxed optional vs non-optional. Maybe that interacts. @priya can you run `pip install -e .[dev] && pre-commit run --all-files`?

priya: running pre-commit now locally. Also seeing a rustfmt job failing in the build logs (some crate formatting changed) — output: `Diff in src/engine/mod.rs at line 54` — will push fix if it's just formatting.

ci-bot: flaky test flagged in matrix: test_integration::test_shard_reconnect (failed 1/3). Not blocking typecheck but worth noting.

matt: thanks. If pre-commit/rustfmt are just style, I can fix those. The mypy error is the blocker. Anyone comfortable with a quick patch to annotate Optional[int] -> int | None and guard assignment? Small change.

lisa: quick triage checklist: 1) reproduce locally, 2) run `tox -e py` or `./scripts/run-typecheck.sh`, 3) run `pre-commit run --all-files`, 4) if unrelated to logic, push formatting patch + rerun. If typecheck, either fix annotations or bisect to find which commit introduced strictness.

alex: I'm free to bisect now. If someone can mark the last known green commit (sha: f9e8d7c6) and confirm a1b2c3d4 is red, I'll run `git bisect run ./scripts/ci-check.sh` and report back.

matt: confirmed: f9e8d7c6 -> green in our local reproduce matrix, a1b2c3d4 -> red. Please run bisect, thanks. :pray:

alex: starting bisect now. I will post the first failing commit and the minimal diff that causes the mypy failure.

(prior to alex finishing) jamie: if bisect points to shared-protos, heads-up that bumping stub versions may require a minor adapt in `kvcache.py` to accept Optional.

alex: bisect result: commit d2f4b678 changed typing for KVRecord in shared-protos and is the first bad commit. Diff snippet:
```
- class KVRecord(TypedDict):
-     value: int
+ class KVRecord(TypedDict, total=False):
+     value: Optional[int]
```

priya: OK that explains it. Two options: a) update kvcache to handle Optional (safe fix), or b) pin shared-protos to the previous typing and revert the bump in the short term. Which do we prefer?

matt: prefer a small kvcache change — less churn. I'll open a quick PR to check for None before assigning.

sara: I'll handle rustfmt and pre-commit formatting fixes in a separate commit and request a rerun of the pipeline.

ci-bot: matt opened PR https://git.internal/r/redwood/pr/4323 to guard Optional assignment. Triggering rerun: `/ci rerun build/9876 --jobs typecheck-py-right,mypy,pre-commit,rustfmt`

matt: done. pinging reviewers @jamie @priya for quick LGTM on the guard.

jamie: taking a look now. If green, please merge and I'll followup to update shared-protos compatibility note in the changelog. :thumbsup:

lisa: post-merge, recommend a short post in #eng summarizing the typing change in shared-protos so other teams are aware.

matt: thanks all — appreciate the quick help.

ci-bot: build/9876 rerun started, will update on completion.
